notes.title: How to solve the problem of cloud save not syncing
notes.content:
If you find that your cloud save files are not syncing, you can try the following methods to solve this problem

1. Changing the download region in Steam

1. After entering the main interface, log in to Steam and click "Steam" in the upper left corner. The menu bar will appear after clicking

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/15e4ad8f692b752b45d41dae9c1a5cdc3bec7750.png

2. Click "Settings" in the menu bar to enter the settings interface, select "Download" and enter the interface

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/b3c0e038771b70d30542c6fcacee940eb437f2c7.png

3. Select Download Region and find the region you want to modify in the drop-down menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/0cc3b349081c5a634ceec88f4ac32daebe8aa60a.png

4. After the modification is completed, a "Restart Required" prompt will appear, then select "Restart Now"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/cdebf6f6e7395208c4b810b9c825da8b010bced6.png

5. After restarting Steam, the download area settings have been changed


2. Retrieve the historical version of Steam Cloud archive and roll back

1. Click Help > Steam Support in the upper left corner of the Steam client menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/360bbe83d6d92afd3bde34c70ff3254cd8c569f9.png

2. Click on "My Account"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/aef1e2ef11503c42439f2af705016a24793c6101.png

3. Click on "Data about your Steam account"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/336ebde28ad0c0b1f8d27696b966305cebd0cf08.png

4. Find and click on Steam Cloud

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/bb7ad4f144ab9c022100d54adc5645c6f676f5f8.png

5. This will bring you to our Steam Cloud archive list. Find "Cute Pets Demolition" and click on the Show Files button on the right.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/c0409055caa79dcca02c1aad036fbb500cc0a438.png

6. Here we can see archives from different times, find the date you need to rewind, and click Download on the right.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/854cd186bb9755e2cce35138b13d82d5212e1089.png

7. Save the file locally and do not modify the file name for now (this way we can retrieve the historical version of the cloud archive back to the local computer. The following steps will import the archive into the game folder)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/0882bf16384777ac6f9a8eb07c4100d521aa2b56.png

8. We can find the specific location of the archive file according to the default file name when downloading. The WinAppDataLocalLow in the front represents C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow. For example, the file name above is %WinAppDataLocalLow%LiquidMeowGames_Messy Up_76561198966449178_PlayerBinaryData_PlayerCakeData.bytes, which corresponds to the PlayerCakeData.bytes file in the C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\LocalLow\LiquidMeowGames\Messy Up\76561198966449178\PlayerBinaryData folder.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/4106163d67bdcc72b3768cd1f0bb6a191aa9d572.png

9. Rename the downloaded file and remove the preceding path information

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/631324db320f5b4604b8009c47fc517c41580186.png

10. Copy the downloaded file to the archive folder to replace it (it is recommended to copy the original archive to another folder for backup first). If the file name has a different suffix, there is no need to replace it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/5851117ac8b2808cd11d4243ba84cce505d403d8.png

11. If you need to change multiple save files, repeat the above steps. This will save the previous cloud save files locally and you can open the game to verify.


It should be noted that there may be no previous saves in the cloud save list. If this happens, this method cannot solve the problem of cloud save synchronization, so protecting local saves is the most important thing. Hope everyone will not be troubled by cloud save problems and play the game happily!

notes.title: How to bind multiple characters to multiple controllers
notes.content:
1. How should I use the corresponding controller to bind the character I want to play with this controller？

In the following modes, we can choose our operation method in the corresponding interface:

1.1 PVE Mode (Story Mode)

In the pet PVE mode, just hover the cursor over the corresponding dotted box, and then press any key on the controller you want to use to add the corresponding recliner (player)! At this time, just drag the character you want to use to the corresponding recliner and use the controller with the previous key to control the character. (If you want to play multiplayer normally, it is recommended to bind only one controller to each character!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/d4c9dbeb1ff1343fda7bfc42e9cf8bf6749f7270.png

1.2 Local PVP/Tutorial/Arcade Levels

The binding methods for local PVP, novice tutorials and arcade levels are similar to those for PVE mode. Use the controller to press any key in the corresponding area to add a character and bind the controller to the key you pressed previously.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/de2936763e51acc15334fd3e2eea42bc632a9580.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/dd8f5ebf75e48637de0179f4b7edf060c42cf368.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/68c3e8e0fa49339a0edc5e6be00d08da240b19a1.png

1.3 Network PVP

In the network PVP mode, you need to click the settings button in the upper left corner to view the currently selected operation mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/e9441da90546c6f092b23dfd6b2791e1b3110ec7.png

In the settings, click the operation mode setting with the game controller icon, select the operation mode you want to use, and then bind it after the game starts. (You can also open the settings panel to set it during the game. But be careful, the network PVP mode cannot be paused!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/ffea7294c20427414a5882570ab68921052ce4ca.png

notes.content:
1. Where can I get currency to buy items？

1.1 Currently, the currencies used to purchase props in the game are mainly the following two：

1.1.1 Candy Coin

It can be obtained in PVE, PVP, Arcade and other levels and some activity tasks, and can be used to purchase items in the store on the main menu interface.

The situations in which candy coins are obtained in the following modes are as follows：

Story PVE/Arcade Mode:
The daily limit for obtaining candy coins is 800 (the candy coin reward for the first three stars in a level is not included in the upper limit, and only the reward obtained by repeatedly playing PVE levels is limited). The number of candy coins obtained in each level is different.

Local PVP mode: 
The daily limit for obtaining candy coins is 500, and you will get 100 candy coins for playing a game.

Online PVP mode: 
The daily limit for obtaining candy coins is 2,200. Depending on the score in the game and whether or not you are the MVP, the number of candy coins each player obtains after the game will be different. (Since the scoring function of the online PVP mode is still problematic, it is being urgently repaired. For the time being, the winner of each online PVP game will receive 200 candy coins, and the loser will receive 100 candy coins)

notes.title: MessyUp FAQ_How to play online
notes.content:
1. Why is the network connection quality so unstable？
1.1 Why can't connect to the room, and it's easy to get disconnected when enter the room？
We can only use Steam's P2P online service,because we don't have enough money to buy a server>^<
Please don't complain that "the server is rubbish". The game has no server. The quality of the network depends on the host's network quality and Steam communication.
MessyUp supports network connection, but the underlying network technology uses Steam's P2P service;
The network stability depends on the quality of the Steam network and the host's network environment;
Simply put, the room host acts as a forwarding server to forward messages, and Steam assists the entire process.
In this case, if the Steam network is not good locally or the host's network quality is poor, the game network connection will be disconnected or unable to connect.
1.2 How to make the network more stable？
The first known method is to use a game accelerator. We have cooperated with some accelerators, which can improve the network condition to a certain extent;
However, some players reported that the network condition is not laggy without the accelerator, but is very laggy after using it. In this case, we recommend that you try it. If it is not laggy, there is no problem;
If it is laggy, try the accelerator. If it is not solved, you can give feedback in the QQ group or Discard group.
1.3 We are glad you share your thoughts
(*｀∀´*)ノ亻!If you have any experience with networking, please let us or our friends know immediately! Thank you very much~

notes.title: Hello, dear players (Θ３Θ), we've rolled out an update.
notes.content:
Hello, fellow players (Θ３Θ)! We've swiftly conducted an update based on the reported BUGs.

New levels, UI updates, improved beginner tutorials, localization additions (partial), bug fixes



 - Added local PvP mode, where you can experience asymmetrical battles between the owner and pets (✪ω✪)
 - Supports remote music sharing, it is recommended to turn on the accelerator to avoid network fluctuations
 - Optimized beginner tutorial prompts and game flow
 - Added scenes outside the room
 - Enhanced level art
 - Adjusted in-game UI
 - Fixed bugs such as the host opening the map, game freeze on completion, and map pathfinding baking


The trial version of the storyline mode covers approximately 15% of the current content, while the full storyline mode takes about 5-8 hours. Online and home modes will only be available in the full version.

Please note that the newly added local PvP is in the testing phase, and various functions are not yet perfect, such as scoring and balance... 
QAQ The save data will be cleared when the official version is launched!!! (Due to active adjustments based on player feedback by the studio staff, the levels in the demo version may not represent the final version, and save data cannot be used after the official version is launched.)

Momo has already achieved the crowdfunding goal of 20,000. Thanks so much for your support! The emojis you've been waiting for are in a new folder! Additional rewards for different tiers are being unlocked, so for those still considering, please lend your support! (｀0´)
